description: Rank the current dirty session — working-tree changes minus preExistingChanges, when you have that list from a job — by blast risk, so a human reads the highest-risk file first. Each file may carry duplicate (looks like an existing symbol), orphan (a new file nothing imports yet), or boundary (crosses into a package this session otherwise doesn't touch) flags. Call this before landing a session, not as a substitute for review_changes' test-impact and breaking-change view.

preExistingChanges.description: Workspace-relative paths already dirty before this session started (e.g. a job's own preExistingChanges). Excluded from the ranking, never silently absorbed.

name: guard_session
title: Guard the current session
